description: Use the AVX-512 GFNI instruction VGF2P8AFFINEQB to perform arbitrary 8x8 bit-matrix transformations on each byte, enabling single-instruction Base64 lookup, validation, and bit-rearrangement. Each byte is multiplied by an 8x8 bit matrix over GF(2) then XORed with a constant.
mathematical_formalization: VGF2P8AFFINEQB(src, matrix, imm8) computes for each byte b_i: result_i = (matrix * b_i) XOR imm8, where multiplication is over GF(2). Decompose Base64 alphabet into affine regions and blend results with mask comparisons.
analogical_connections: Cryptography: AES SubBytes uses the same GF(2^8) inverse + affine transform
Error correction: Reed-Solomon encoding multiplies data by generator matrix over GF(2^8)
Digital logic: any combinational logic of 8 inputs can be expressed as affine + nonlinear terms
implementation_hypothesis: Decompose the Base64 decode table into affine regions, compute an affine matrix M_i per region, blend results using mask comparison. Requires ~4 VGF2P8AFFINEQB + 3 mask blend operations.
experiment_seed: Implement GF-affine Base64 lookup and compare instruction count and throughput against PSHUFB-bitmask. Verify on all 256 input byte values.
